title: Add root Gradle project for monorepo builds
description: Replace build.sh with a proper Gradle composite build at the repo root so that a single './gradlew build' (or check/clean) drives all four services — backend Gradle + frontend npm — with parallel execution and IDE support.
design:
## Goal
Replace the proprietary build.sh with a root-level Gradle composite build that calls each service's backend (Gradle) and frontend (npm) builds through standard Gradle tasks.

## Context
- Four services: kdiab-measures, kdiab-profiles, kdiab-treatments, kdiab-bff
- All services already use Gradle 9.4.1 with their own settings.gradle.kts and version catalogs
- Each service's root build.gradle.kts currently only has the asciidoctor docs plugin
- No root-level Gradle project exists today
- build.sh handles parallel Gradle + npm builds via shell background processes

## Approach: Gradle Composite Builds
Each service stays an independent Gradle project (own settings.gradle.kts, version catalog, wrapper). Root uses includeBuild() to compose them. Services still build standalone via their own ./gradlew; root ./gradlew delegates to all four.

## Files to Create

### Root level (/home/triplem/projects/kdiab/)
- settings.gradle.kts — includeBuild for each of the four services
- build.gradle.kts — aggregate tasks: build, check, clean, buildDocker
- gradlew + gradle/wrapper/* — copied from any service (all use Gradle 9.4.1)
- gradle.properties — org.gradle.parallel=true, org.gradle.caching=true

### Root settings.gradle.kts
```kotlin
rootProject.name = "kdiab"
includeBuild("kdiab-measures")
includeBuild("kdiab-profiles")
includeBuild("kdiab-treatments")
includeBuild("kdiab-bff")
```

### Root build.gradle.kts
```kotlin
tasks.register("build") {
    dependsOn(
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-measures").task(":buildAll"),
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-profiles").task(":buildAll"),
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-treatments").task(":buildAll"),
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-bff").task(":buildAll"),
    )
}
tasks.register("check") {
    dependsOn(
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-measures").task(":checkAll"),
        ...
    )
}
tasks.register("clean") {
    dependsOn(
        gradle.includedBuild("kdiab-measures").task(":cleanAll"),
        ...
    )
}
```

## Files to Modify

### Each service's root build.gradle.kts (kdiab-*/build.gradle.kts)
Add frontend and aggregate tasks:
```kotlin
tasks.register<Exec>("buildFrontend") {
    workingDir = file("frontend")
    commandLine("bash", "-c", "npm ci --silent && npm run build")
    inputs.dir("frontend/src")
    inputs.file("frontend/package-lock.json")
    outputs.dir("frontend/dist")
}

tasks.register<Exec>("checkFrontend") {
    workingDir = file("frontend")
    commandLine("bash", "-c", "npm ci --silent && npm run lint && npm run test")
}

tasks.register("buildAll") {
    dependsOn(":backend:build", "buildFrontend")
}

tasks.register("checkAll") {
    dependsOn(":backend:check", "checkFrontend")
}

tasks.register("cleanAll") {
    dependsOn(":backend:clean")
    doLast {
        delete("frontend/dist")
    }
}
```

## Root Task Mapping
| ./gradlew command         | What runs                                    |
|---------------------------|----------------------------------------------|
| build                     | buildAll in all four services (parallel)     |
| check                     | checkAll in all four services                |
| clean                     | cleanAll in each service                     |

## What Stays in build.sh
The --clean Docker/volume teardown and --docker image build stay in build.sh. Alternatively buildDocker can be added as an exec task in root build.gradle.kts that calls 'docker compose build'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- ./gradlew build from repo root compiles all 4 backends and builds all 4 frontends
- ./gradlew check from repo root runs all tests, detekt, kover, and frontend lint/test for all services
- ./gradlew clean removes all build outputs
- Each service still builds independently via its own ./gradlew
- Parallel flag (./gradlew build --parallel) speeds up builds as build.sh --no-parallel does
- IDE (IntelliJ) can import the root project and see all four services as modules

## Risks
- npm wrapped in Exec tasks has no Gradle incremental support unless inputs/outputs are declared carefully
- Composite build task references (gradle.includedBuild().task()) cannot be used in dependsOn inside included builds themselves — only at root level
- If services diverge to different Gradle versions in future, root wrapper version needs updating

design:
# OpenSpec: kdiab-carbs — Personal Food Database Microservice (kdiab-x3s)

## Goal
Create a new Kotlin/Ktor/PostgreSQL microservice `kdiab-carbs` that gives each user a personal food database. Entries store a food name, a typical portion size in grams, and the carb content per 100g — enabling the service to compute carbs for any portion. A simple CRUD frontend in kdiab-ui lists food entries. When a CARBS treatment is logged, the user can search their food database to pre-fill the carbs value automatically.

---

## Context

### Existing service anatomy (kdiab-measures is the reference)
- Root: `kdiab-measures/` — Gradle composite build, no sub-`backend/` directory; sources at `src/main/kotlin/...`
- `settings.gradle.kts` — `rootProject.name = "kdiab-measures"`
- `build.gradle.kts` — declares all Ktor/Exposed/JUnit5 deps, openApiGenerate config, kover, detekt, buildAll/checkAll/cleanAll aliases
- `api/openapi.yaml` — single source of truth for codegen
- `src/main/kotlin/.../Application.kt` — wires all plugins + routes
- `src/main/resources/application.conf` — HOCON with JWT, CORS, storage, swagger sections (all overridable via env vars)
- `Dockerfile` — copies `build/libs/<name>-all.jar`, runs as non-root user `ktor`
- `Dockerfile.liquibase` — runs Liquibase migrations
- Root `settings.gradle.kts`: `includeBuild("kdiab-measures")` pattern, needs new `includeBuild("kdiab-carbs")`
- Root `build.gradle.kts`: `buildBackends`, `check`, `clean`, `dockerBuild` tasks reference all 4 services — needs kdiab-carbs added
- Root `config/postgres/01-init-databases.sh`: creates one DB per service — needs `CREATE DATABASE "kdiab-carbs";`
- Root `docker-compose.yml`: one block per service (liquibase, backend) — needs two new blocks
- `kdiab-ui/vite.config.ts`: proxy per service (`/api/carbs` → localhost:8085)
- Port allocation: 8080 measures, 8082 profiles, 8083 treatments, 8084 analyze → **8085 carbs**

---

## Interface Changes

### New: kdiab-carbs/api/openapi.yaml


FoodEntryResponse schema:
```
id: string (UUID)
userId: string (UUID)
name: string
portionGrams: number
carbsPer100g: number
carbsForPortion: number   (computed = portionGrams * carbsPer100g / 100, included in response)
createdAt: string (ISO-8601)
updatedAt: string (ISO-8601)
```

CreateFoodEntryRequest: `{ name, portionGrams, carbsPer100g }`
UpdateFoodEntryRequest: `{ name, portionGrams, carbsPer100g }`
PagedFoodResponse: `{ items: [FoodEntryResponse], page, size, totalCount }`

### kdiab-ui changes
- New `src/api/carbsApi.ts`
- New `src/features/carbs/FoodDatabase.tsx`
- Modified `src/features/treatments/AddTreatmentModal.tsx` — food search in CARBS field
- Modified `src/i18n/locales/en.json` and `de.json` — new `carbs` key group
- Modified `vite.config.ts` — proxy `/api/carbs` → localhost:8085

### Root infrastructure changes
- `settings.gradle.kts` — add `includeBuild("kdiab-carbs")`
- `build.gradle.kts` — add kdiab-carbs to all aggregate tasks
- `config/postgres/01-init-databases.sh` — add `CREATE DATABASE "kdiab-carbs";`
- `docker-compose.yml` — add `liquibase-carbs` and `carbs-backend` service blocks
- `config/keycloak-realm.json` — add `carbs` audience to relevant Keycloak clients

import { axiosInstance } from './axiosInstance'

const BASE = '/api/carbs/v1'

export interface FoodEntryResponse {
  id: string
  userId: string
  name: string
  portionGrams: number
  carbsPer100g: number
  carbsForPortion: number
  createdAt: string
  updatedAt: string
}

interface PagedFoods {
  items: FoodEntryResponse[]
  page: number
  size: number
  totalCount: number
}

export const carbsApi = {
  listFoods: (userId: string, page = 0, size = 50, q?: string) =>
    axiosInstance.get<PagedFoods>(`${BASE}/users/${userId}/foods`, {
      params: { page, size, ...(q ? { q } : {}) },
    }),
  createFood: (userId: string, body: { name: string; portionGrams: number; carbsPer100g: number }) =>
    axiosInstance.post<FoodEntryResponse>(`${BASE}/users/${userId}/foods`, body),
  updateFood: (userId: string, foodId: string, body: { name: string; portionGrams: number; carbsPer100g: number }) =>
    axiosInstance.put<FoodEntryResponse>(`${BASE}/users/${userId}/foods/${foodId}`, body),
  deleteFood: (userId: string, foodId: string) =>
    axiosInstance.delete(`${BASE}/users/${userId}/foods/${foodId}`),
}

## Risks & Assumptions
- **Keycloak client setup**: The `kdiab-analyze-frontend` client in `config/keycloak-realm.json` already has audience mappers for 4 services. Adding a 5th mapper for `carbs` allows the same JWT to authenticate against kdiab-carbs. Inspect the existing mapper format before adding.
- **AddTreatmentModal userId prop**: TreatmentList.tsx currently passes no userId to AddTreatmentModal. The userId is available from the `useUserInfo()` hook in TreatmentList — thread it through the prop.
- **Debounced search**: The food search in AddTreatmentModal uses a 300ms debounce to avoid spamming requests while typing. Clean up the effect timer on unmount.
- **ilike operator**: Exposed's `ilike` for case-insensitive LIKE may not exist in all Exposed versions. Fallback: use `.lowerCase() like "%${nameFilter.lowercase()}%"` pattern.
- **H2 integration tests**: The measures service uses H2 in-memory for integration tests with Liquibase. kdiab-carbs must configure H2 in `application-test.conf` the same way (driver `org.h2.Driver`, url `jdbc:h2:mem:test;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;MODE=PostgreSQL`). Check how kdiab-measures test config is set up.
- **Port conflict**: If port 8085 is already used, choose the next free port. Update docker-compose.yml, application.conf, and vite.config.ts consistently.
- **Gradle wrapper**: The new `kdiab-carbs/` must have its own `gradlew` script and `gradle/wrapper/` directory. Copy from kdiab-measures.
